description: Operator-authoritative security declarations for the reproduction harness. resultTaintLabels are DECLARED facts about a tool's outputs (no DLP, no heuristic secret scanning anywhere in this pack); sinks are declared facts about where a tool writes; capabilitiesRequired is DECLARED permission intent supplied by the fixture author (never inferred from detection signals). The gateway treats a trusted profile as authoritative for classification and sink resolution. v3 additions power the permission-model pairs (P1-P4): read_tenant_doc / read_workspace / publish_file (profiled tools exercising capability grants, tenant isolation, and consent) and get_status_page (descriptor-only, used under an operator-supplied custom rule that expresses the route policy).

unprofiled_echo.description: echo text (no security profile registered — descriptor only)

read_tenant_doc.description: read a tenant document by resource path

publish_file.description: publish a document to the external archive

get_status_page.description: get a status page (no security profile registered — descriptor only; route policy is supplied by the operator's custom rule in fixture P4)

structured_sink.description: ingest a structured payload to the external archive

profileSetSemantics.full: as declared above (search_docs and transform_text outputs carry the operator-declared 'secret' label); structured_sink (v1.3.0) is the object-accepting deny-sink used by S4
profileSetSemantics.no-labels: identical tool set, but resultTaintLabels is STRIPPED from every profile at load time — used by fixture N2 to prove the runtime never invents labels
profileSetSemantics.full-unprofiled: the full set plus unprofiled_echo, whose descriptor is registered but whose security profile is deliberately absent — the hardened gateway escalates it to ask_user; used by D2/D3
profileSetSemantics.probe: gateway-probe set for the ledger-eviction fixtures E1/E2: a secret-labeled source, an internal-labeled (non-sensitive) source, and the deny-sink
profileSetSemantics.perm: permission-pair set for P1/P2: a capability-gated cross-tenant reader, an open reader, and a capability-gated external write (consent path exercised on the write)
profileSetSemantics.route: descriptor-only get_status_page for P3/P3b/P4; heuristically classified read_only, so the unprofiled-tool boundary rule applies to it on unverified boundaries, and P4's operator rule supplies the route allow/deny line
